_meta.what: Businesses known to have closed, with the month they closed (closed_from) where known. Simulations of earlier years keep them; forward estimates (outlooks, forecasts for a new business) treat them as closed from that month. Google Places closures (data/google_places.json, CLOSED_PERMANENTLY) are added by the build with closed_from = the date Google was checked, because Google does not say when they closed.
_meta.fields: key = the business's OpenStreetMap id (or source:name:address); closed_from = YYYY-MM; evidence = what shows it; source = who observed it.
